warnings.title: NAVAREA XIX 114/2026
warnings.text: 1.THE NORWEGIAN GOVERNMENT HAS DECIDED THAT RUSSIAN FISHING VESSELS ONLY HAVE ACCESS TO THE FOLLOWING THREE PORTS ON THE NORWEGIAN MAINLAND: A.BAATSFJORD (NOBJF) B.KIRKENES (NOKKN) C.TROMSOE (NOTOS) A BAN ON ACCESS TO OTHER PORTS ON THE NORWEGIAN MAINLAND WILL APPLY FOR RUSSIAN FISHING VESSELS FROM 132200 UTC OCT 2022. 2.
